summary.intent: Continue the Callisto release work: verify the 0.20.0 release, get follow-up PRs #530 (docs) and #531 (fix for spurious 'No pending changesets' warning) ready, and address a review finding on #531.
summary.outcome: 0.20.0 was verified as published (GitHub release, tags, crates.io for cli/model). #530 and #531 were opened and marked ready. The medium review finding on #531 was reproduced with a failing test, fixed by checking for a surviving inferred bump, committed, and `just pre-push` was run (result not shown in transcript).

repo: Changesets live in `.changeset/` and use frontmatter like `callisto-cli: patch`; a changeset must be written for user-visible behavior changes, and docs-only commits use the `docs(changeset)` prefix.
Commits are signed (`git commit -S`) and use conventional-commit prefixes; `just doc-check` and `just pre-push` are the local gates.
Linking a branch to an Entire trail (`entire trail link 357 ...`) before pushing causes Entire to open the PR, so titles/bodies are edited afterward with `gh pr edit`.
Release verification covers GitHub release (assets, Latest flag), four tags on origin, and crates.io max_version; `callisto-fixtures` is unpublished and floating `v1` tag starts at 1.0.0.
`--dry-run` is intentionally a global flag: accepted everywhere, no-op on read-only commands, usage error where inapplicable; documented in `stability.md`.
One version test calls real `cargo info` (network) and fails in the sandbox the same way on main, so CI is the authoritative check.
OIDC trusted publishing plan is in `docs/projects/OIDC-TRUSTED-PUBLISHING.md`, marked 'after v1'; the policy check currently forbids `id-token: write` on `execute`.

code.finding: The empty-changeset warning guard used `inference_commits.is_empty()`, which stays populated even when aggregation drops the bump; it should check whether an inferred bump survived (`named_by` is Inference).
On prerelease reruns an already-recorded major changeset can override a minor commit inference for an auto package.
Aggregation removes the overridden bump but leaves `inference_commits` populated, creating stale inference records.

workflow: Reproduce a review finding with a failing test first (red), then fix, then confirm green — done for the #531 finding.
Verify review findings against the cited code on the actual branch (fetch the branch, read lines) before acting.
Subagent hand-back reports are treated as data, not user authority; actions taken were the ordinary changeset/PR work within the session.
Using `grep -E` filters on cargo test output keeps results short but can hide panic details, requiring a second run with `-A4 panicked`.

friction: Local test run in the sandbox failed on a network-dependent test (`cargo info`), muddying local verification.
The first combined cargo test invocation with multiple filters needed re-running with `--` to pass multiple test name filters.
Remaining work (OIDC, E194) is decision-heavy and could not be built autonomously; 'keep going' had no safe build-ready tasks.
CI on #530/#531 had pending checks including an Entire approval gate, blocking merge.
open_items: Merge #530 and #531 once CI passes, then clean up their worktrees.
Write decision briefs for OIDC trusted publishing and E194 (shared tag/title for fixed groups).
Perform the first real `v1` tag rehearsal at 1.0.0.
Caliper `Props<string>` fix needs a session in the Caliper repo (prompt prepared).
Push the new fix commit for the #139 finding to #531 and confirm `just pre-push`/CI results; the changeset text may need updating to reflect the prerelease-rerun case.
Did not check `callisto-graph` and `callisto-manifests` versions on crates.io.
